power.name: MAX
power.note: Advanced mode: press A+B+C with at least 1 power stock to activate MAX (time gauge); attack power rises while it lasts and DMs done during MAX become SDMs. Extra mode: hold A+B+C to charge the POW gauge manually; DMs are available with a full (MAX) gauge or a flashing life bar, and become SDMs with both.
